rules.Unless in same sentence (regex): 目标|力争|计划|将于|到20\d\d|认证|填埋|target|aim|by 20\d\d|certif|landfill|情景|scenario|NGFS|IEA|净零排放部|Net Zero|净零|在\s*20\d\d|20\d\d\s*年(前|左右|底|实现)
rules.Why it matters: Absolute claims rarely hold across a whole operation and are the first thing regulators and NGOs challenge.
rules.What good looks like: State the scope (which site/product), the boundary, the period and who verified it.
rules.Lower if (regex): (废水|污水|雨水|污泥|废气|危废|危险废物|渗滤液|冷凝水|中水|填埋|wastewater|landfill)\S{0,6}(零排放|零填埋)|(零排放|zero (liquid )?discharge)\S{0,4}(废水|wastewater)
rules.Evidence elsewhere (regex, {m} = match): {m}.{0,80}(监测|检测|认证|核查|第三方)|(监测|检测|认证|核查|第三方).{0,80}{m}
rules.Why it matters (CN): 绝对化表述很难在整个运营范围内成立，也是监管机构和非政府组织最先质疑的内容。
rules.What good looks like (CN): 说明范围（哪个场所/产品）、边界、期间，以及由谁验证。

rules.Pattern CN (regex): (已|已经|实现了?|达成)(碳中和|净零|零碳)|零碳(工厂|园区|产品|基地)|碳中和(工厂|产品|园区|基地)
rules.Unless in same sentence (regex): 范围|抵消|PAS\s?2060|ISO\s?14068|核证|认证|scope|offset|verified|certif|目标|路径|情景|打造|建设|入选|试点|名单|target|pathway|scenario|NGFS|IEA
rules.Why it matters: A neutrality claim without scope and offset detail is the classic greenwashing case (EU Green Claims rules ban unsubstantiated ones).
rules.What good looks like: Name the scopes covered, absolute reductions achieved, offsets used (type, volume, registry) and the standard (ISO 14068 / PAS 2060).
rules.Lower if (regex): (国家级|省级|市级|评定|评选|授予|认定|入选|称号|绿色工厂|灯塔工厂)
rules.Evidence elsewhere (regex, {m} = match): {m}.{0,80}(认证|核证|核查|PAS2060|ISO14068|SGS|TÜV|必维|DNV|中环联合|评价)|(认证|核证|核查|PAS2060|ISO14068).{0,80}{m}
rules.Why it matters (CN): 未说明范围和抵消情况的碳中和声明，是典型的漂绿。
rules.What good looks like (CN): 说明涵盖的范围（范围一/二/三）、实际减排量、所用抵消（类型、年份、注册机构）及认证标准。

rules.Pattern CN (regex): (碳汇|碳信用|CCER|碳抵消|抵消).{0,30}(中和|净零)
rules.Why it matters: Neutrality bought with credits says little about the company's own emissions.
rules.What good looks like: Report reductions and offsets separately; disclose credit type, vintage and registry.
rules.Lower if (regex): VCS|Verra|Gold Standard|黄金标准|CCER|I-?REC|核证自愿减排
rules.Why it matters (CN): 靠购买碳信用实现的“中和”，很难说明企业自身的排放表现。
rules.What good looks like (CN): 分别报告减排量和抵消量；披露碳信用类型、年份和注册机构。

rules.Unless in same sentence (regex): 202[5-9]|2030年?前|中期|阶段性|SBTi|interim|near[- ]term|国家|响应|national|情景|scenario|NZE|PAS\s?2060
rules.Why it matters: A 2050/2060 target with no interim milestone cannot be tracked by readers.
rules.What good looks like: Add interim targets (e.g. 2030) with a base year and the scopes covered.
rules.Why it matters (CN): 只有 2050/2060 目标而没有中期里程碑，读者无法跟踪进展。
rules.What good looks like (CN): 增加有基准年和覆盖范围的中期目标（如 2030 年）。

rules.Pattern CN (regex): (排放|能耗|能源|用电|电量|用水|耗水|水耗|碳|废|物料|材料|包装|纸)\S{0,15}(降低|减少|下降|减排|削减)了?\s*\d+(\.\d+)?\s*[%％]
rules.Unless in same sentence (regex): 基准|较|相比|同比|比20\d\d|与20\d\d|上年|baseline|base year|compared|from 20\d\d|vs\.?|against|year[- ]on[- ]year|\byoy\b|改造|替换|升级|项目|案例|retrofit|replac|upgrade|project
rules.Why it matters: A percentage without a baseline cannot be checked or compared.
rules.What good looks like: Give the base year, base value and current value.
rules.Why it matters (CN): 没有基准的百分比无法核对或比较。
rules.What good looks like (CN): 给出基准年、基准值和当前值。

rules.Why it matters: A target with no deadline is not a commitment.
rules.What good looks like: Every target: value, unit, base year, target year.
rules.Why it matters (CN): 没有期限的目标不算承诺。
rules.What good looks like (CN): 每个目标都写明数值、单位、基准年和目标年。

rules.Pattern CN (regex): (强度|单位产值|单位产品|万元产值).{0,15}(下降|降低|减少)
rules.Why it matters: Intensity can fall while absolute emissions keep rising.
rules.What good looks like: Show absolute totals next to intensity.
rules.Evidence elsewhere (regex, {m} = match): (温室气体|碳)排放总量|总排放量|范围[一1][、和及与+]范围?[二2]
rules.Why it matters (CN): 强度下降时，绝对排放量仍可能上升。
rules.What good looks like (CN): 在强度旁边同时列出绝对总量。

rules.Pattern CN (regex): 100%\s*(可再生|绿电|清洁能源|绿色电力)
rules.Why it matters: 100% renewable usually relies on certificates; without that, readers can't tell how it was achieved.
rules.What good looks like: Split on-site generation, PPAs and certificates; state the market/location-based Scope 2 method.
rules.Why it matters (CN): 100% 可再生通常依赖绿证；不说明则读者无法判断。
rules.What good looks like (CN): 分别列出自发电、购电协议和绿证；说明基于市场还是基于地点的口径。

rules.Pattern CN (regex): 行业领先|国际领先|全球领先|国内领先|业内首创|行业首个|最环保|最绿色
rules.Unless in same sentence (regex): 排名|评级|获评|第\d|rank|rating|awarded|第一|首位|首家.{0,10}(认证|获评)|No\.\s?1
rules.Why it matters: Superlatives without evidence are marketing, not disclosure.
rules.What good looks like: Cite the ranking, rating or benchmark that supports the claim.
rules.Why it matters (CN): 没有证据的“领先”是营销语言，不是披露。
rules.What good looks like (CN): 引用支持该说法的排名、评级或基准。

rules.Pattern CN (regex): 环保型|环保(产品|材料)|绿色(产品|材料)|生态友好|环境友好
rules.Why it matters: 'Eco-friendly' with no criteria is the most common greenwashing term.
rules.What good looks like: Name the certification, standard or LCA result behind the label.
rules.Why it matters (CN): 没有标准的“环保”是最常见的漂绿用语。
rules.What good looks like (CN): 说明标签背后的认证、标准或生命周期评价结果。

rules.Pattern CN (regex): 可生物降解|可降解|可回收|可循环利用
rules.Unless in same sentence (regex): 认证|标准|GB|ISO|EN\s?13432|certif|%|可回收\S{0,12}\d[\d,.]*\s*(万?吨|立方米|m3|kg|千克|t\b)
rules.Why it matters: Degradable/recyclable depends on conditions and local infrastructure.
rules.What good looks like: Give the standard, test conditions and the share of products it applies to.
rules.Category (CN): 可降解 / 可回收声明
rules.Why it matters (CN): 可降解、可回收取决于条件和当地回收设施。
rules.What good looks like (CN): 说明标准、测试条件，以及适用的产品比例。

rules.Pattern CN (regex): 零(事故|伤亡|投诉|违规|处罚|泄露)|未发生.{0,10}(事故|违规|处罚|泄露|事件)
rules.Why it matters: 'Zero' depends on definitions: are contractors and all sites included? Is 'major' defined?
rules.What good looks like: State the definition, the sites/people covered and the period.
rules.Why it matters (CN): “零”取决于定义：是否包括承包商和所有场所？
rules.What good looks like (CN): 说明定义、覆盖的场所和人员，以及期间。

rules.Pattern CN (regex): 100%\s*(合规|覆盖|签订|参保|达标|审核)
rules.Why it matters: 100% needs a denominator: 100% of what?
rules.What good looks like: State the denominator (e.g. 100% of 1,250 Tier-1 suppliers by spend).
rules.Why it matters (CN): 100% 需要分母：100% 的什么？
rules.What good looks like (CN): 写明分母（例如：按采购额计 1,250 家一级供应商的 100%）。

rules.Pattern CN (regex): 力争|争取|努力|积极(探索|推进|践行)|持续(推进|关注)|不断(完善|提升)
rules.Why it matters: High density of vague verbs means few measurable statements.
rules.What good looks like: Replace with what was done, how much, by when.
rules.Why it matters (CN): 模糊动词越多，可衡量的表述越少。
rules.What good looks like (CN): 改为写做了什么、做了多少、何时完成。

rules.Pattern CN (regex): (排放|能耗|用水|数据).{0,20}(主要|部分|重点)(工厂|基地|子公司|生产基地|运营)
rules.Why it matters: Data from selected sites can hide the worst ones.
rules.What good looks like: List which entities are in and out of each metric and why.
rules.Why it matters (CN): 只选部分场所的数据可能掩盖表现最差的场所。
rules.What good looks like (CN): 列出每项指标包含和不包含哪些主体及原因。

rules.Pattern CN (regex): (荣获|获评|入选).{0,20}(绿色|ESG|可持续|低碳)
rules.Why it matters: Awards are not performance data.
rules.What good looks like: Keep awards in a separate section; back claims with metrics.
rules.Why it matters (CN): 奖项不是绩效数据。
rules.What good looks like (CN): 将奖项单独列示；用指标支撑表述。

rules.Pattern CN (regex): 清洁(煤|燃煤)|天然气.{0,10}清洁能源
rules.Why it matters: Calling fossil fuels clean is a recognised greenwashing pattern.
rules.What good looks like: Describe it as lower-carbon than the alternative, with the numbers.
rules.Category (CN): 把化石燃料称为清洁能源
rules.Why it matters (CN): 把化石燃料称为“清洁”是公认的漂绿模式。
rules.What good looks like (CN): 说明其比替代方案碳排放更低，并给出数字。

rules.Why it matters: Blanket supplier claims rarely state how compliance was verified.
rules.What good looks like: Say how many suppliers, which tier, by what method (audit, SAQ, SLCP) and the findings.
rules.Why it matters (CN): 笼统的供应商声明很少说明如何核实。
rules.What good looks like (CN): 说明供应商数量、层级和方法（审核、问卷、SLCP 等）。

rules.Pattern CN (regex): (不存在|杜绝|无|未发现)(任何)?(童工|强迫劳动)
rules.Why it matters: Absence claims need evidence of how the company looked.
rules.What good looks like: Describe the due diligence: scope, method, findings, remediation.
rules.Category (CN): “不存在”声明（童工 / 强迫劳动）
rules.Why it matters (CN): “不存在”需要说明企业是怎么查的。
rules.What good looks like (CN): 描述尽职调查：范围、方法、发现和整改。

rules.Pattern CN (regex): 体面工资|生活工资
rules.Why it matters: A living wage claim without a benchmark can't be checked.
rules.What good looks like: Name the benchmark (e.g. Anker) and the share of workers paid at or above it.
rules.Why it matters (CN): 没有基准的生活工资声明无法核对。
rules.What good looks like (CN): 说明基准（如 Anker）以及达到或超过该基准的工人比例。

terms.Term (regex): ZDHC|有毒有害化学物质零排放|有害化学物质零排放|Zero Discharge of Hazardous Chemicals
terms.Note: ZDHC is a programme name (Zero Discharge of Hazardous Chemicals), not an absolute claim.

terms.Term (regex): 零排放(汽车|车辆|卡车|重卡|客车|公交)|zero[- ]emission (vehicle|truck|bus|car)s?
零碳(工厂|园区)\S{0,8}(标准|评价规范|评价要求|团体标准|指南|试点)
terms.Note: Reference to a zero-carbon factory standard or pilot scheme, not a claim.

terms.Term (regex): (碳中和|净零|零碳)\S{0,6}(路径|路线图|规划|愿景|承诺|目标)|(助力|推动|支持|服务)\S{0,10}(碳中和|净零|零碳)
terms.Note: Ambition or contribution to a national goal, not a claim of having achieved it.

standards.Name (CN): 交易所《可持续发展报告指引》(2024)
standards.Detect (regex): 自律监管指引第\s*1[147]\s*号|可持续发展报告\s*[（(]试行[)）]|Self-Regulatory Guidelines?.{0,60}No\.\s*1[147]
standards.Note (EN): SSE No.14 / SZSE No.17 / BSE No.11.
standards.Note (CN): 上交所第14号 / 深交所第17号 / 北交所第11号。

standards.Detect (regex): GRI\s*(标准|Standards?|内容索引|Content Index|1\s*[:：])|全球报告倡议|Global Reporting Initiative
standards.Note (CN): 通用标准（GRI 2、3）与议题标准（200-400 系列）。

standards.Detect (regex): IFRS\s*S[12]|\bISSB\b|国际可持续准则理事会|国际财务报告可持续披露准则
standards.Note (EN): S1 general requirements and S2 climate.
standards.Note (CN): S1 一般要求与 S2 气候。

standards.Name (CN): 港交所《环境、社会及管治报告守则》（附录 C2）
standards.Detect (regex): 香港联合交易所|联交所|\bHKEX\b|Stock Exchange of Hong Kong|环境、社会及管治报告(指引|守则)|ESG Reporting (Guide|Code)|附录\s*(C2|二十七|27)|Appendix\s*(C2|27)
standards.Note (EN): Part B mandatory, Part C comply-or-explain, Part D climate.
standards.Note (CN): B 部分强制披露，C 部分不遵守就解释，D 部分气候披露。

standards.Name (CN): IFC 绩效标准（参考视角）
standards.Detect (regex): IFC\s*(Performance Standards?|绩效标准)|国际金融公司.{0,6}绩效标准
standards.Note (EN): Written for projects IFC finances, not for corporate reports - expect lower scores.
standards.Note (CN): 为 IFC 融资项目制定，并非企业报告准则，得分通常偏低。

standards.Name (CN): 评级机构关键议题（公开清单）
standards.Note (EN): Built from the key-issue lists ESG raters such as MSCI publish. Not an MSCI rating and not affiliated with any rater. Sector-specific issues are shown but not scored.
standards.Note (CN): 依据 MSCI 等评级机构公开的关键议题清单整理；不是 MSCI 评级，与任何评级机构无关。行业特定议题只显示、不计分。

standards.Detect (regex): \bTCFD\b|气候相关财务信息披露工作组
standards.Note (EN): Detected only; covered by ISSB S2.
standards.Note (CN): 仅识别；内容已由 ISSB S2 覆盖。

standards.Detect (regex): \bSASB\b|可持续发展会计准则委员会
standards.Note (EN): Detected only; industry metrics not checked yet.
standards.Note (CN): 仅识别；暂不检查行业指标。
